name: eirberg-admin
description: A staff-only Eirberg admin workspace for ChatGPT and Codex. Preview package; service activation is pending.

interface.longDescription: An admin workspace for authorized Eirberg staff, connected directly to Eirberg’s hosted MCP service and Medusa. The initial integration supports news and homepage banners, with draft previews, reviewed changes and operation receipts. Store access and permitted actions are determined by your Medusa staging staff account and connection consent. This alpha distributes the installation package; the merchant service is not yet active. Installing it does not make the backend available or grant store access.
defaultPrompt: Help me review changes to the Eirberg homepage banners.
